proposed_logic: We do not offer refunds on annual plans under any circumstances; customers may cancel to stop future renewals only.
existing_logic: Annual subscriptions can be refunded up to 60 days after purchase.

proposed_logic: No enterprise discount may exceed 15% regardless of approver.
existing_logic: The maximum enterprise discount is 25% with sales director approval.

note: refinement, not conflict — adds an approval detail
proposed_logic: Enterprise-tier tickets must receive a first response within 2 hours, 24/7; responses must come from a named engineer, not an auto-reply.
existing_logic: Enterprise-tier tickets must receive a first response within 2 hours, 24/7.

proposed_logic: Every chargeback is disputed with full evidence regardless of amount — never accept a chargeback without contesting it.
existing_logic: Do not dispute chargebacks below $100 — accept and refund them; blocklist customers after their second chargeback.

note: adds a channel, keeps the rule
proposed_logic: P1 tickets unacknowledged for 15 minutes escalate to the on-call EM, and a summary is posted in #incidents at the same time.
existing_logic: If a P1 sits with no acknowledgement for 15 minutes, escalate straight to the on-call EM.

proposed_logic: Customer event data must be deleted after 90 days; nothing may be retained beyond one quarter.
existing_logic: Customer event data is retained for 13 months and then hard-deleted; backups age out after 35 days.

note: narrower scope carve-out, base rule intact
proposed_logic: For registered nonprofits only, the refund window extends to 90 days; all other customers keep the standard windows.
existing_logic: Monthly subscriptions can be refunded up to 30 days after purchase; annual subscriptions up to 60 days.

proposed_logic: A single strong yes from either technical interviewer is sufficient to extend an offer.
existing_logic: Candidates need a definite yes from both technical interviewers to receive an offer.

note: same rule with added documentation step
proposed_logic: Purchases under $250 need no pre-approval, but must still be tagged with a cost center when expensed.
existing_logic: Purchases under $250 need no pre-approval; $250–$2,000 needs written manager approval; above $2,000 goes through procurement.

note: payment terms conflict net-45 vs net-30
proposed_logic: All vendor invoices are paid on net-30 terms without exception.
existing_logic: New vendor contracts use net-45 payment terms; contracts above $50k/year require CFO signature.
